# RELEASE


## DETAILS


## Uniti Group Inc. to Participate at the J.P. Morgan 2026 U.S. Opportunities Forum


November 5, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.uniti.com/node/16926/pdf)


LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Uniti Group Inc. (“Uniti”) (Nasdaq: UNIT) announced today that its Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer, Paul Bullington, is scheduled to participate as part of a panel at the J.P. Morgan 2026 U.S. Opportunities Forum on November 12, 2026 in Miami, FL.


**ABOUT UNITI**


Uniti (Nasdaq: UNIT) is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy. Our broad portfolio of services is offered through a suite of brands: Uniti Wholesale, Kinetic, Uniti Fiber, and Uniti Solutions. Visit us online at[www.uniti.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Pw9cyDfW-uoplQyeq2_kGwutC35TievhRIePmDVnbnGHm6mhBoo9oohAvhLyuUdOfxRvO6jpZEw4unItyqlzKw==) .
